summary: BRT Apartments Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering up to $16,000,000 of common stock issuable under its Dividend Reinvestment Plan. Shares may be sold from time to time at a discount of 0% to 5%, currently 3%, to the market price; no underwriter or advisor is named, and no board recommendation is disclosed beyond plan administration. The NYSE-listed stock (BRT) closed at $13.70 on September 24, 2026. This is a routine at-the-market DRIP takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and pricing discount dynamics.
